hints.title: Bucketing Values by Range
hints.text: Group numbers into buckets of width valueDiff plus one while sliding a window of size indexDiff.

hints.title: Adjacent Bucket Proximity Check
hints.text: Any matching candidate must fall either in the exact same bucket or an immediately adjacent bucket.

hints.title: Bucket Dictionary Sliding Window
hints.text: Define bucket width w = valueDiff + 1. Map number x to bucket key = x // w. In a window of size indexDiff, if bucket key exists, return true. If key - 1 exists and abs(x - buckets[key - 1]) <= valueDiff, return true. Check key + 1 similarly. Evict elements older than indexDiff.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal linear time bucketing sliding window.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparing all pairs in window takes O(N * K) which is too slow for large indexDiff.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash table bucketing reduces neighbor search to O(1) checks.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use bucket width valueDiff + 1 and check only current, previous, and next buckets.
